title: Paid Monthly Rate Used to Convert Held-Back Amounts - Montgomery GI Bill Rate Bands
content:
**Rate band table — Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education), conversion of an amount held back on a Post-9/11 election into days.**

**Paid monthly rate.** The student's paid monthly rate is the flat monthly payments issued in the twelve months before today summed and divided by the days they paid, times 30.

**Rate it converts at.**
- a paid monthly rate of at least the three-quarter-time rate converts at the three-quarter-time rate when it is below the full-time rate;
- a paid monthly rate of at least the half-time rate and below the three-quarter-time rate converts at the half-time rate;
- any other paid monthly rate converts at the full-time rate.

The rates are those of the relinquished chapter's tier:

| Chapter relinquished | Paid monthly rate band | Converts at |
|---|---|---|
| Montgomery GI Bill - Active Duty (Chapter 30) | $1888.50 or more and below $2518.00 | $1888.50 |
| Montgomery GI Bill - Active Duty (Chapter 30) | $1259.00 or more and below $1888.50 | $1259.00 |
| Montgomery GI Bill - Active Duty (Chapter 30) | $2518.00 or more, or below $1259.00 (including no payments in the period) | $2518.00 |
| Montgomery GI Bill - Selected Reserve (Chapter 1606) | $368.00 or more and below $493.00 | $368.00 |
| Montgomery GI Bill - Selected Reserve (Chapter 1606) | $243.00 or more and below $368.00 | $243.00 |
| Montgomery GI Bill - Selected Reserve (Chapter 1606) | $493.00 or more, or below $243.00 (including no payments in the period) | $493.00 |

**Hypothetical Chapter 30 cases.**
- Two monthly payments of $1888.50 for 30 days each: $3777.00 over 60 days, times 30, is $1888.50 — converts at $1888.50.
- One payment of $1000.00 for 20 days: times 30 divided by 20 is $1500.00 — converts at $1259.00; an amount of $629.50 held back is then 629.5 times 30 divided by 1259, 15 days.
- Payments totalling $2518.00 for 30 days: converts at $2518.00.
